new.s: According to Ziauddin Barani, why was the Delhi Sultanate not a truly Islamic state?
o: The Sultans refused to recognise the Caliph
The Sultans framed their own state regulations (zawabit) beside the sharia
The Sultans appointed Hindus as qazis
new.x: Barani held that the Sultans ruled by their own regulations (zawabit) along with the sharia, so the state was not truly Islamic.
new.angle: U0115 #9 Barani's view - zawabit vs sharia

new.s: What did Ziauddin Barani call the state regulations framed by the Sultans beside the sharia?
new.x: Barani called the Sultans' own state laws zawabit; he set out his ideal of rule in Fatawa-i-Jahandari.
new.angle: U0115 #9 Barani - zawabit
